message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-11 13:10 IST to 2026-09-12 13:10 IST (2026-09-11 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-12 07:40 UTC)

This isolated DLL-component scan read, normalized, and deduplicated only `DLL_software_component.txt`. No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours matched a component in that file. The mandatory independent MongoDB ecosystem sweep found two high-scoring driver/integration issues newly surfaced in a Canadian government advisory during the window.

### Findings

**Finding 1 — MongoDB Java Driver reactive encryption use-after-free (CVE-2026-88032)**

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Java Driver before 5.11.1; MongoDB also identifies affected `mongodb-crypt` and reactive-streams packages before 5.11.1.
- **Severity:** CVSS 8.2 (MongoDB score).
- **Description:** Cancelling a reactive client-side encryption operation while KMS credentials are being fetched can race with native-context cleanup, causing a use-after-free and potentially crashing the application process.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB drivers are part of the mandatory ecosystem sweep. Canada’s Cyber Centre newly highlighted the Java Driver issue on September 11; MongoDB’s vendor record confirms the CVE, affected versions, and technical impact.
- **Sources:** [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security AV26-911](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/mongodb-security-advisory-av26-911), [MongoDB alert catalog](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB JAVA-6276](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/JAVA-6276)

**Finding 2 — Laravel MongoDB query-operator injection (CVE-2026-88022)**

- **Affected product/component:** Laravel MongoDB (PHP) before 5.11.0.
- **Severity:** CVSS 8.4 (MongoDB score).
- **Description:** Array values supplied to explicit equality filters can be interpreted as MongoDB query operators, allowing crafted input to disclose or delete documents where applications pass unvalidated input into affected query-builder paths.
- **Relevance:** Official MongoDB integrations are part of the mandatory ecosystem sweep. Canada’s Cyber Centre newly highlighted Laravel MongoDB on September 11; MongoDB’s vendor record confirms the CVE and affected version range.
- **Sources:** [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security AV26-911](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/mongodb-security-advisory-av26-911), [MongoDB alert catalog](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB PHPLARA-260](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PHPLARA-260)

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB-owned notices whose titles may omit “MongoDB,” GitHub advisories, CVE/NVD records, CISA-oriented sources, and credible government reporting.

MongoDB’s underlying vendor entries for these two issues are dated September 10, outside the strict window; they are included because the Canadian government advisory newly reported and linked them on September 11 within this run’s window. Other MongoDB issues dated September 10 or earlier were excluded because no credible in-window report or material update was verified.

### Closing

Prompt review is recommended for applications using MongoDB Java Driver reactive client-side encryption or Laravel MongoDB versions below the fixed releases. No immediate review trigger was found for components listed in `DLL_software_component.txt` based on credible reports within this 24-hour window.
